description: Vectors check the stored-proof check on its own (stored-proof equality as type-preserving structural JSON equality, and the subject part). compositionCases is a decision-composition table: its inputs are the stored-proof check result (pass, fail-stored-proof, fail-subject) and the parser outcome (pass, fail, indeterminate, error-executed for a parser that ran and returned error, error-pra5-preinvocation for the PRA-5 error returned before the parser is invoked); its output is the final outcome. The model composes outcomes only; it does not run a parser, and it does not decide what a parser returns. fail-subject with error-pra5-preinvocation is not a reachable pair (no parser ran, so no subject resolved) and is omitted. The set's count and hash cover vectors only.

vectors.name: string-subject-differs-by-case-only
vectors.note: exact equality after NFC; no case folding

vectors.name: number-subject-with-string-user-id
vectors.note: a JSON number is not converted to text

vectors.name: string-subject-with-number-user-id
vectors.note: the stored userId is a JSON number; the digits as a string do not match it

vectors.name: number-subject-with-equal-number-user-id
vectors.note: a non-string on either side fails closed, even when both are the same number

vectors.name: proof-stored-under-another-hash
vectors.note: proof-body-b is a valid proof stored under H2; the entry stored for H1 holds proof-body-a, so only the stored-proof part decides

vectors.name: hash-resolves-to-no-stored-entry
vectors.note: H resolves to no stored entry

vectors.name: declared-subject-resolves-to-nothing
vectors.note: dataMap declares subject and the expression resolves to nothing

vectors.name: subject-equal-after-nfc
vectors.note: decomposed subject, precomposed stored userId; equal after NFC

vectors.name: no-subject-declared-stored-proof-supplied
vectors.note: no subject entry is declared, so the check adds nothing beyond the stored-proof match

vectors.name: no-subject-declared-numeric-user-id-passes
vectors.note: with no subject entry the stored userId is not read

vectors.name: no-subject-declared-other-proof-fails
vectors.note: the stored-proof part fails on its own when no subject entry is declared

vectors.name: structured-proof-members-in-another-order
vectors.note: same members in a different order, in the outer and the nested object

vectors.name: boolean-true-stored-number-one-supplied
vectors.note: a number never equals a boolean

vectors.name: number-one-stored-boolean-true-supplied
vectors.note: a boolean never equals a number

vectors.name: number-one-and-one-point-zero-are-equal
vectors.note: numbers are equal when they have the same numeric value

vectors.name: array-elements-in-another-order
vectors.note: arrays are equal element by element in order

vectors.name: supplied-proof-has-a-duplicate-member-name
vectors.note: if the last member won, the supplied proof would equal the stored proof; a duplicate member name fails the check

vectors.name: string-one-stored-number-one-supplied
vectors.note: a string never equals a number

compositionCases.name: pass-with-parser-pass
compositionCases.note: both parts pass and the parser passes

compositionCases.name: pass-with-parser-error-pra5-preinvocation
compositionCases.note: a declared subject needs a parser result; the PRA-5 error stands

compositionCases.name: fail-stored-proof-with-parser-pass
compositionCases.note: the stored-proof fail stands over a parser pass

compositionCases.name: fail-stored-proof-with-parser-error-executed
compositionCases.note: the stored-proof fail stands over an executed parser error

compositionCases.name: fail-stored-proof-with-parser-error-pra5-preinvocation
compositionCases.note: the stored-proof fail stands over a PRA-5 error returned before the parser is invoked

compositionCases.name: fail-subject-with-parser-pass
compositionCases.note: the subject part turns a parser pass into fail

compositionCases.name: fail-subject-with-parser-indeterminate
compositionCases.note: a parser indeterminate stands; the subject part applies only on a parser pass

compositionCases.name: fail-subject-with-parser-error-executed
compositionCases.note: a parser error stands; the subject part applies only on a parser pass
